page.overview:
Who is Charlie Degler?

Charles "Charlie" Degler is the son of Ellie and Mark Degler. He first appeared in .

Charlie is first seen as a three-year-old playing with a Brachiosaurus toy and a Triceratops, Alan Grant, a friend of Ellie tries to tell him that herbivores wouldn't want fight, but carnivores would love to fight. When his dad came, he introduces Alan as the "Dinosaur Man".

Alan later calls, trying to get Ellie's help, but Charlie answers the phone. After some distraction, he finally gives the phone to Ellie and tells her that it's the Dinosaur Man.

When Alan asks Ellie how are her kids, Ellie reveals that Charlie, now 24, and his younger sibling are doing great and both are in college, while she is now divorced from Mark.
